home.metaTitle: Paraguay Investor Pass — Direct Permanent Residency by Investment
home.metaDescription: The Investor Pass grants permanent residency without the temporary stage. Qualifying routes, documents and timelines, confirmed in writing before you commit.
home.h1: Permanent residency in Paraguay, in one step.
home.sub: The Investor Pass lets qualifying investors skip temporary residency entirely. We structure the investment, file the application and stay with you until the permanent card is in your hand.

quiz.h1: Is the Investor Pass your route?
quiz.sub: Six questions. We will tell you honestly when the standard residency route is the better deal for your case — it often is.

contact.metaDescription: Tell us your capital, your timeline and your goal. We come back with the qualifying route that fits, the full cost and the exit options — in writing.
